spans.s:
रिश् रिश् (according to some an older
form of rt. 1. लिश्, q. v.; closely connected
with rt. 1. रिष्, from which, in some forms and
meanings, it is not distinguishable; cf. also rts. रुश्,
1. रुष्), cl. 6. P. रिशति, रिरेश, रेक्ष्यति, अरि-
क्षत्, रेष्टुम्, Ved. to tear, rend, tear off, break
off, pluck off, injure, hurt; to feed on, graze: Caus.
रेशयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरीरिशत्: Desid. रिरिक्षति,
to wish to injure: Intens. रेरिश्यते, रेरेष्टि; [cf.
Slav. resati, ‘to cut.’]

रिष् 1. रिष् (closely connected with rt.
रिश्, from which, in some forms and mean-
ings, it is not distinguishable; cf. also rts. रुश्,
1. रुष्), cl. 1. 4. P. रेषति, रिष्यति (in ep. and
later authors also A. रिष्यते), रिरेष, रेषिष्यति,
अरेषीत् or अरिषत् (Vedic forms रिषत्, रिषाम,
रिषाथन, रेषत्, रीषत), रेषितुम् or रेष्टुम्
(Ved. inf. रिषे), to injure, hurt, harm; to kill,
destroy, ruin; to give offence; to be injured or
destroyed, suffer wrong, perish (cl.4); to fail, mis-
carry, meet with misfortune or disaster (cl. 4): Caus.
रेषयति, -यते, -यितुम्, Aor. अरीरिषत्, अरीरि-
षत, to cause to be injured, injure, hurt, harm; to
cause to miscarry, make to fail; to fail, miscarry,
meet with misfortune or disaster (A.): Desid. रिरि-
षिषति, रिरेषिषति, (according to some also रि-
रिक्षति): Intens. रेरिष्यते, रेरेष्टि; [cf. pro-
bably Gr. ῥαίω, ῥαιστός; Lat. lœdo.]
2. रिष्, ट्, f. injury; (ट्, ट्, ट्), injuring, an injurer.

रिश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. tearing, tearing off, injur-
ing; (अस्), m. an injurer, enemy.

रिष, अस्, आ, अम्, injuring, destroying, &c.; [cf.
नघा-रिष.]

रिशत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, Ved. tearing, injuring,
hurting; feeding or grazing upon, consuming, (Sāy.
= भक्षणार्थं हिंसत्.)

रिशादस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (a word of doubtful derivation
and meaning; said to be fr. रिश, an enemy, + अद
[]
fr. rt. अद्), Ved. destroying those who injure, de-
stroying enemies, epithet of the Maruts, &c.; [cf.
Ṛg-veda

1. रिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. रिष्ट see below),
Ved. torn, torn off, broken, injured; wearied.

2. रिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see above), injured,
hurt, wounded; unlucky; (according to some also)
lucky; (अम्), n. mischief, harm; misfortune, bad luck
(= अरिष्ट); destruction, loss; sin; (according to
some also) good luck, prosperity; (अस्), m. a sword;
the soap plant, Sapindus Detergens; N. of a king;
of a Daitya or demon (destroyed by Viṣṇu); of a
son of a Manu; (आ), f., N. of the mother of the
Apsarases.
—रिष्ट-ताति, इस्, इस्, इ, causing prosperity,
propitious; auspicious; [cf. शिव-ताति.]
—रिष्ट-
देह, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded in body.
रिश्य रिश्य, अस्, m. = ऋश्य, an antelope.

रिष्य रिष्य, अस्, m. = ऋष्य, ऋश्य.
—रिष्य-मूक, अस्, m. = ऋष्य-मूक.
रिषण्य, Nom. P. रिषण्यति, &c. (Pāṇ.

), Ved. to injure, harm, be hurtful; to reject
(a petition); to fail, miscarry.

रिषण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. injurious, hurtful, ma-
levolent, (Sāy. = हिंसक.)

रिषीक, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) destroying, destruc-
tive, injurious.
रिष्टक, अस्, m. Sapindus Detergens.

रिष्टि, इस्, f. injury, hurt, damage; failure, mis-
carriage, misfortune, bad luck; (according to some)
good luck; इषु-रिष्टि, ‘the going astray or swerv-
ing of an arrow,’ N. of a Sāman; (इस्), m. = ऋष्टि,
a sword, (according to some also इस्, f.)

रिष्टीय, Nom. P. रिष्टीयति, &c. = रिषण्य
above.
रिष्व, अस्, आ, अम्, injurious, hurtful, mischievous.
रिषि रिषि, इस्, m. = ऋषि.
रिष्फ रिष्फ, अम्, n. = रिःफ.
